responsibility: Implements the selective scheduler’s private IR and region/CFG support layer. It owns region and basic-block metadata vectors, list and pool allocators for instruction/boundary/fence structures, regset and nop pools, loop-preheader and loop-region bookkeeping for pipelining, and numerous utilities for initializing per-insn data, manipulating scheduled regions, and maintaining scheduler-specific CFG structures. It is the data-structure and region-management implementation that underpins sel-sched.c’s scheduling algorithm.
same_name_distinction: This same-stem source file implements the selective scheduler's internal IR and region/CFG support machinery, including metadata vectors, pools, list operations, and loop-preheader/region management. The companion header gcc/sel-sched-ir.h defines that private IR and the APIs/macros used across the selective-scheduling subsystem.
